title: Latin American Cities (in English)
description: Introduces the history, culture, politics, arts, cinema and urban landscape of iconic cities in Latin America such as Havana, Mexico City and Buenos Aires. Examines the works of important writers and artists, as well as meaningful events, places and landmarks. Main focus is on the modern and contemporary periods, while providing relevant information about the cities’ centennial histories to better contextualize recent developments.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of LAS 309, SPAN 305A (if taken in the same topic), SPAN 309.
